title: TransferDetails v1
description: Fields shared by every transfer event. They carry what the aml-monitor rules need: both accounts, the beneficiary name for sanctions screening, the amount, the channel and the maker/checker pair for segregation-of-duties checks.

sourceAccountId.description: Debited account. Also the Kafka partition key, so a source account's transfers arrive in order.

beneficiaryName.description: Recipient name as entered by the maker; screened against sanctions lists.

channel.description: Channel through which the transfer was initiated. Monitoring rules use it to apply channel-specific thresholds.

checkerUserId.description: User who decided on the transfer as checker: who approved it, or who rejected it (TransferFailed with failureCode REJECTED_BY_CHECKER). Null when nobody decided: below the approval threshold transfers are approved automatically, and an approval that expired (APPROVAL_EXPIRED) has no checker. When not null it is always different from makerUserId.
